Criterion: Verify that the aerial refueling system has been designed to minimize the hazards from lightning, static electricity, fuel leaks, ignition sources, and ground potential. Standard: The aerial refueling system is designed to minimize the hazards caused by direct lightning strikes, static electricity, fuel leaks, ignition sources, and ground potential (see also 8.3 and 8.4, this document). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis of design, Safety Hazard Analysis, inspection of drawings, and laboratory tests verify risks are within defined acceptable limits. References: JSSG-2009: E.3.4.5.8.11, E.4.4.5.8.11; F.3.4.6.1.7, F.4.4.6.1.7; G.3.4.7.2, G.4.4.7.2; G.3.4.7.3, G.4.4.7.3; G.3.3.4.7.6, G.4.4.4.7.6 MIL-HDBK-516: 8.3, 8.4
